title: imprint with data
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkImprintFilter with point and cell data processing by imprinting a cylinder-derived trim loop onto a volume plane, showing three renderers for cell data, target-edge interpolation, and imprint-edge interpolation of point data.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkContourLoopExtraction](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContourLoopExtraction.html) — contour loop extraction.
- [vtkCylinder](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCylinder.html) — defines an implicit cylinder function.
- [vtkCylinderSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCylinderSource.html) — generates a polygonal cylinder.
- [vtkFlyingEdgesPlaneCutter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFlyingEdgesPlaneCutter.html) — cuts a volume with a plane using the flying edges algorithm.
- [vtkImprintFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImprintFilter.html) — imprint filter.
- [vtkOutlineFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkOutlineFilter.html) — generates a bounding box outline of the input data.
- [vtkPlane](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlane.html) — defines an implicit plane function.
- [vtkPointDataToCellData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPointDataToCellData.html) — point data to cell data.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkPolyDataPlaneClipper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataPlaneClipper.html) — poly data plane clipper.
- [vtkSampleFunction](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSampleFunction.html) — evaluates an implicit function on a regular grid.
- [vtkSampleImplicitFunctionFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSampleImplicitFunctionFilter.html) — sample implicit function filter.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
